name: Tourist Visa / Visa on Arrival / Business Visa (short-stay)

requirements.blocker_text: Travel for tourism, visiting friends/relatives, seminars/conferences/workshops, study tours, or religious purposes.
Invitation letter from a Bangladeshi citizen (with their ID) OR an organizational invitation OR a hotel booking confirmation.
Invitation letter from a recognized Bangladeshi business organization plus a letter from the sponsoring foreign company.

evidence_required.document: Valid passport (6+ months validity, 2 blank pages)

outcome.duration_length: Tourist Visa: up to 3 months single-entry, extendable by up to 1 additional month; Business Visa: up to 1 year validity (single/double/multiple entry), 30 days max per visit, extendable up to 3 years total (6 months max per visit on extension); Visa on Arrival: available to 24+ nationalities, up to 30 days

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Bangladesh (Embassy of Bangladesh, Doha) -- Tourist Visa: up to 3 months single-entry, extendable by 1 month via the Department of Immigration and Passport (DIP), requires invitation/booking evidence and financial documentation

High Commission for the People's Republic of Bangladesh, New Delhi -- Business Visa: up to 1 year validity, 30 days max per visit, extendable up to 3 years via DIP with local sponsor and police clearance

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bangladesh). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- both sources tier-1 official diplomatic missions. Visa on Arrival (24+ eligible nationalities, up to 30 days) is folded into this file's duration_length rather than modeled as a separate requirement group, consistent with this dataset's established approach for short-stay VOA variants. E-visa application runs through visa.gov.bd; specific per-nationality fee schedules were not independently retrieved in this build (fees vary by reciprocity arrangement with the applicant's home country, per the Student Visa sourcing pattern seen in bd_student_permit.json).
